methods.measures: Coverage of matched positions; baseline proper-fit RMSD and unsigned rotation by chain pair.
methods.scope: One deposited model and assembly of matching observed chains. Baseline differences do not measure the effect of excluding a segment.

methods.measures: Refit each same-deposition chain pair after leaving out one fixed label-position interval. Inspect the absolute change of the unsigned rotation angle (degrees) and fitted RMSD (angstrom), separately. The named maxima summarize eligible pair/interval cells; the full table preserves eligibility, all three chain pairs and the separate median summaries.
methods.parameters: common_backbone requires N, CA, C, O and common_ca requires CA. Retain the input digest, mask, denominator, coverage and omitted blocks.

methods.measures: Extract a selected pair and interval from an existing named block table using the registered row selectors.
methods.scope: This reads an existing result. It does not create a new independent observation.

domain: Describe deposited coordinate completeness and sensitivity of the reported geometry within a single archive entry. Coverage alone cannot determine sensitivity. Unknown or insufficient observations are reported as unavailable. A shared chain label across different entries does not identify the same independent sample.
